def_zh: n. 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情；vi. 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私
def_en: n. a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee

examples.en: She just got a new job at the bank.
examples.zh: 她刚在银行找到一份新工作。

def_zh: n. 话, 消息, 词, 诺言, 命令；vt. 用言辞表达
def_en: n. a unit of language that native speakers can identify

examples.en: I didn't understand the last word she said.
examples.zh: 她说的最后一个词我没听懂。

def_zh: num. 四, 四个；四冲程循环
def_en: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of three and one

examples.en: The hotel room has four small wooden chairs.
examples.zh: 这间酒店房间里有四把小木椅。

def_zh: n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端；vi. 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下
def_en: n. an important question that is in dispute and must be settled

examples.en: We discussed the issue of plastic pollution in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上讨论了塑料污染这个问题。

def_zh: n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统；a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
def_en: n. a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location

examples.en: The kitchen is on the left side of the house.
examples.zh: 厨房在房子的左侧。

def_zh: n. 种类, 性质, 方式；a. 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的
def_en: n. a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality

examples.en: She is always kind to younger students.
examples.zh: 她对年纪小的同学总是很亲切。

def_zh: n. 头, 头脑, 领袖, 脑袋, 最前的部分；vt. 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶
def_en: n. the upper part of the human body or the front part of the body in animals; contains the face and brains

examples.en: He nodded his head to show he agreed.
examples.zh: 他点了点头，表示同意。

def_zh: a. 远的, 久远的, 遥远的；adv. 甚远地, 很, 到很深的程度, 到很远的距离
def_en: a. located at a great distance in time or space or degree

examples.en: The nearest town is quite far from here.
examples.zh: 最近的镇子离这里相当远。

def_zh: n. 黑色, 黑颜料；a. 黑色的
def_en: n. the quality or state of the achromatic color of least lightness (bearing the least resemblance to white)

examples.en: She wore a simple black dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一条朴素的黑色连衣裙去参加派对。

def_zh: a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的；vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
def_en: a. primarily temporal sense; being or indicating a relatively great or greater than average duration or passage of time or a duration as specified

examples.en: We waited a long time for the bus.
examples.zh: 我们等公交车等了很久。

def_zh: a. 两者的；adv. 两者都
def_en: s. (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two

examples.en: Both of my parents are doctors.
examples.zh: 我父母两人都是医生。

def_zh: n. 一点点, 少许, 一会儿, 短时间；a. 小的, 很少的, 幼小的, 琐碎的, 短暂的, 矮小的
def_en: n. a small amount or duration

examples.en: Add a little salt to improve the flavor.
examples.zh: 加一点盐能让味道更好。

def_zh: n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭；vt. 给...房子住, 收藏
def_en: n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families

examples.en: They are building a new house by the lake.
examples.zh: 他们正在湖边盖一栋新房子。

def_zh: adv. 是；n. 是, 同意
def_en: n. an affirmative

examples.en: She said yes to his polite invitation.
examples.zh: 面对他礼貌的邀请，她答应了。

def_zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来；adv. 自那时以后
def_en: adv. From a definite past time until now; as, he went a month

examples.en: We have known each other since childhood.
examples.zh: 我们从小就认识。

def_zh: n. 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门；vt. 保养, 维修
def_en: n. work done by one person or group that benefits another

examples.en: The hotel offers excellent service to its guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店为客人提供优质的服务。

root_affix: 词根 serv(服务;保留)→ 服务

def_zh: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处；adv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处
def_en: r. by a circular or circuitous route

examples.en: We walked around the old town all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们绕着古镇逛了一整个下午。

def_zh: n. 朋友, 支持者, 赞助者；朋友, 友人, 赞助者
def_en: n. a person you know well and regard with affection and trust

examples.en: My best friend lives just down the street.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友就住在这条街上不远处。

def_zh: n. 父亲, 祖先, 长辈, 神父, 创始者；vt. 当...的父亲, 保护, 创作, 发明, 培养
def_en: n. a male parent (also used as a term of address to your father)

examples.en: My father taught me how to ride a bike.
examples.zh: 我爸爸教会了我怎么骑自行车。

def_zh: vi. 坐, 就座, 坐落；vt. 使就座, 骑
def_en: v. be seated

examples.en: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
examples.zh: 请坐下，随意一点。

def_zh: adv. 离去
def_en: s. not present; having left

examples.en: The shop is only five minutes away.
examples.zh: 那家店只有五分钟路程。

def_zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前；conj. 直到...时, 在...以前
def_en: prep. To; unto; towards; -- used of material objects.

examples.en: The shop stays open until ten every night.
examples.zh: 这家店每晚营业到十点。

def_zh: n. 力, 体力, 力量, 势力, 动力, 权力, 强国, 乘方, 强度, 幂, 功率；vt. 使...有力量, 供以动力, 激励
def_en: n. possession of controlling influence

examples.en: Solar panels turn sunlight into electric power.
examples.zh: 太阳能板把阳光转化成电力。

def_zh: n. 小时, 钟头, 时间, ...点钟, 课时
def_en: n. a period of time equal to 1/24th of a day

examples.en: The journey takes about an hour by train.
examples.zh: 坐火车这段路程大约要一个小时。

def_zh: n. 比赛, 玩耍, 比分, 得胜, 比赛规则, 策略, 游戏, 野味；vi. 赌博
def_en: n. a contest with rules to determine a winner

examples.en: We played a board game after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们玩了一局桌游。

def_zh: adv. 时常, 常常
def_en: r. in many cases or instances

examples.en: They often go hiking on the weekend.
examples.zh: 他们周末经常去远足。

def_zh: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而；conj. 然而
def_en: r. up to the present time

examples.en: The package has not arrived yet.
examples.zh: 包裹还没送到。

def_zh: n. 列, 线, 绳, 电线, 线路, 路线, 航线, 作业线, 界线, 战线, 外形, 排, 家系；vt. 排成一行, 顺...排列, 划线于, 加衬里, 使有线条, 使起皱纹
def_en: n. a formation of people or things one beside another

examples.en: Please wait in line until your number is called.
examples.zh: 请排队等候，叫到你的号码再上前。

def_zh: n. 结束, 终点, 目标, 末端, 梢, 死亡, 残余；v. 结束, 终结, 终止
def_en: n. either extremity of something that has length

examples.en: The film has a surprising end.
examples.zh: 这部电影有一个出人意料的结局。

def_zh: prep. 在...之中
def_en: prep. Alt. of Amongst

examples.en: She was the tallest among all her friends.
examples.zh: 在所有朋友中她个子最高。

def_zh: adv. 曾经, 究竟, 永远
def_en: r. at any time

examples.en: Have you ever visited a foreign country?
examples.zh: 你曾经去过外国吗？

def_zh: n. 站立, 站住, 停顿, 讲台, 看台, 立场, 法院证人席；vi. 站, 立, 坐落, 停滞, 位于, 坚持, 维持原状
def_en: n. the position where a thing or person stands

examples.en: Please stand up when the judge enters.
examples.zh: 法官进场时请起立。

def_zh: a. 坏的；n. 坏
def_en: n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency

examples.en: The weather was really bad during our trip.
examples.zh: 我们旅行期间天气非常糟糕。

def_zh: vt. 遗失, 损失, 丢失, 使失去, 错过, 浪费, 迷失, 使迷路, 输去, 使沉溺于；vi. 受损失, 失败
def_en: v. fail to keep or to maintain; cease to have, either physically or in an abstract sense

examples.en: Try not to lose your temper so easily.
examples.zh: 尽量别这么容易发脾气。

def_zh: n. 成员, 会员；│肢, 肢体
def_en: n. one of the persons who compose a social group (especially individuals who have joined and participate in a group organization)

examples.en: She is an active member of the local choir.
examples.zh: 她是当地合唱团的一名活跃成员。

def_zh: n. 薪资, 付款, 补偿；vt. 支付, 付清, 补偿, 偿还, 对...有利, 为...涂防水物
def_en: v. give money, usually in exchange for goods or services

examples.en: You can pay by card or in cash.
examples.zh: 你可以刷卡支付，也可以付现金。

def_zh: n. 法律, 法则, 定律, 法律的制约, 法学, 司法界, 诉讼；v. 起诉
def_en: n. the collection of rules imposed by authority

examples.en: Everyone must obey the traffic law.
examples.zh: 每个人都必须遵守交通法规。

def_zh: n. 会, 集会；a. 适宜的, 合适的

examples.en: Let's meet at the cafe around noon.
examples.zh: 我们中午左右在咖啡馆见吧。

def_zh: n. 汽车, 客车；车
def_en: n. a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine

examples.en: He washes his car every weekend.
examples.zh: 他每个周末都洗车。

def_zh: n. 城市, 市；都市, 城市, 市
def_en: n. a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts

examples.en: This city is famous for its old bridges.
examples.zh: 这座城市以它古老的桥梁而闻名。

def_zh: n. 社区, 公众, 共有, 共同体；公众, 共有, 社会
def_en: n. a group of people living in a particular local area

examples.en: The whole community helped rebuild the school.
examples.zh: 整个社区都来帮忙重建学校。

root_affix: 前缀 com-(共同;一起) + 后缀 -ity(名词后缀:性质;状态)

def_zh: n. 名字, 名称, 姓名, 名义, 名誉, 文件名；vt. 命名, 称呼, 任命, 提名, 列举
def_en: n. a language unit by which a person or thing is known

examples.en: Please write your full name at the top.
examples.zh: 请在最上方写下你的全名。

def_zh: num. 五, 五个
def_en: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one

examples.en: The bakery sells five kinds of fresh bread.
examples.zh: 这家面包店出售五种新鲜面包。

def_zh: adv. 一次, 曾经, 一旦；conj. 一旦, 一经
def_en: r. on one occasion

examples.en: I visit my grandparents once a week.
examples.zh: 我每周去看望一次祖父母。

def_zh: n. 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白；a. 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
def_en: n. a member of the Caucasoid race

examples.en: The walls were painted a clean white.
examples.zh: 墙壁被刷成了干净的白色。

def_zh: n. 最少, 最小, 最小限度；a. 最少的, 最小的
def_en: n. something that is of no importance

examples.en: At least three people agreed with the plan.
examples.zh: 至少有三个人赞成这个方案。

def_zh: n. 总统, 总裁, 董事长, (学院)院长, (大学)校长, 主管人, 主持人；总经理, 董事长, 总裁
def_en: n. an executive officer of a firm or corporation

examples.en: The president gave a speech to the nation.
examples.zh: 总统向全国发表了讲话。

root_affix: 前缀 pre-(在…之前) + 后缀 -ent(形容词/名词后缀:…的;…者)

def_zh: vt. 学习；认识到；得知
def_en: v. gain knowledge or skills

examples.en: Children learn new words very quickly.
examples.zh: 孩子们学新单词学得很快。

def_zh: a. 真的, 真实的, 实际的, 实在的, 不动(产)的, 实数的；n. 实数, 现实
def_en: n. the basic unit of money in Brazil; equal to 100 centavos

examples.en: This necklace is made of real gold.
examples.zh: 这条项链是用真金做的。

def_zh: n. 队, 组；vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组
def_en: n. a cooperative unit (especially in sports)

examples.en: Our team won the match by two goals.
examples.zh: 我们队以两球的优势赢得了比赛。

def_zh: n. 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记；vt. 记录, 摘录, 测定时间
def_en: n. a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour

examples.en: Please wait one minute while I check.
examples.zh: 请稍等一分钟，我查一下。

def_zh: a. 几个的, 一些的, 各自的；pron. 几个
def_en: s. (used with count nouns) of an indefinite number more than 2 or 3 but not many

examples.en: She has visited Paris several times.
examples.zh: 她去过巴黎好几次。

def_zh: n. 主意, 办法, 理想, 思想, 概念, 意见；观念, 思想
def_en: n. the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about

examples.en: That is a great idea for the project.
examples.zh: 对这个项目来说那是个好主意。

def_zh: n. 小山羊, 小山羊肉, 小孩, 欺骗；a. 小山羊皮制的
def_en: n. soft smooth leather from the hide of a young goat

examples.en: The kid laughed at the funny clown.
examples.zh: 那个小孩被滑稽的小丑逗笑了。

def_zh: n. 身体, 人, 尸体, 主要部分, 团体；vt. 赋以形体
def_en: n. the entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being)

examples.en: Regular exercise keeps your body healthy.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体保持健康。

def_zh: n. 无, 不关紧要之事, 零；adv. 毫不, 决不
def_en: n. a quantity of no importance

examples.en: There was nothing left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱里什么都不剩了。

def_zh: adv. 以前
def_en: s. gone by; or in the past

examples.en: I moved to this city two years ago.
examples.zh: 我两年前搬到了这座城市。

def_zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的；n. 联欢会
def_en: a. relating to human society and its members

examples.en: Humans are naturally social creatures.
examples.zh: 人类天生就是群居动物。

root_affix: 词根 soci(同伴;社会) + 后缀 -al(…的)→ 社会的

def_zh: conj. 是否, 不论；pron. 两个中的哪一个
def_en: pron. Which (of two); which one (of two); -- used

examples.en: I'm not sure whether it will rain today.
examples.zh: 我不确定今天是否会下雨。

def_zh: n. 观察, 手表, 看守, 守护, 监视, 值班人；vt. 看, 注视, 照顾, 看守, 守护, 监视
def_en: n. a small portable timepiece

examples.en: We like to watch the sunset from the hill.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢从山上看日落。

def_zh: n. 父母, 父母亲, 根源；父亲, 母亲, 根源
def_en: n. a father or mother; one who begets or one who gives birth to or nurtures and raises a child; a relative who plays the role of guardian

examples.en: Every parent wants the best for their child.
examples.zh: 每位父母都想给孩子最好的。

def_zh: n. 停止, 车站, 逗留, 填塞, 障碍, (风琴的)音栓；vi. 停止, 被塞住
def_en: n. the event of something ending

examples.en: The bus will stop right outside the school.
examples.zh: 公交车会停在学校门口。

def_zh: n. 脸, 面容, 正面, 外观；vt. 面对, 朝, 正视, 面临
def_en: n. the front of the human head from the forehead to the chin and ear to ear

examples.en: A warm smile spread across her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上绽放出温暖的笑容。

def_zh: pron. 任何事
def_en: n. Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatever; thing of

examples.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
examples.zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

def_zh: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言；vt. 说, 讲, 说出
def_en: v. use language

examples.en: She can speak three languages fluently.
examples.zh: 她能流利地说三种语言。

def_zh: n. 水平, 水准, 平地；a. 同高的, 平坦的, 齐平的, 水平的
def_en: n. height above ground

examples.en: The water rose to a dangerous level.
examples.zh: 水位上涨到了危险的程度。

def_zh: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和；vi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添
def_en: v. make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of

examples.en: Add some sugar if the tea is too bitter.
examples.zh: 如果茶太苦就加点糖。

def_zh: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责；办公室
def_en: n. place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed

examples.en: Her office is on the fifth floor.
examples.zh: 她的办公室在五楼。

def_zh: vt. 花费, 浪费, 度过, 消耗, 消磨；vi. 花费, 用尽
def_en: v. pass time in a specific way

examples.en: I try not to spend too much on coffee.
examples.zh: 我尽量不在咖啡上花太多钱。

root_affix: 词根 pend(悬挂;称量;支付)

def_zh: n. 门
def_en: n. a swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle

examples.en: Please close the door quietly behind you.
examples.zh: 请随手轻轻把门关上。

def_zh: n. 健康, 卫生, 蓬勃, 健康状态；健康
def_en: n. a healthy state of wellbeing free from disease

examples.en: Good sleep is important for your health.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠对你的健康很重要。

def_zh: n. 人, 人身, 人称；人, 法人, 人身
def_en: n. a human being

examples.en: She is a very honest and reliable person.
examples.zh: 她是个非常诚实可靠的人。

def_zh: n. 艺术, 美术, 技艺
def_en: n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively

examples.en: The museum has a fine collection of modern art.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆有一批精美的现代艺术藏品。

def_zh: a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的；adv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地
def_en: s. physically secure or dependable

examples.en: I'm not quite sure about the answer.
examples.zh: 我对这个答案不太确定。

def_zh: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争；vi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗
def_en: n. the waging of armed conflict against an enemy

examples.en: The two countries finally ended the long war.
examples.zh: 两国终于结束了这场漫长的战争。

def_zh: n. 宴会, 党, 政党, 团体, 当事人, 聚会；v. 举办聚会
def_en: n. an organization to gain political power

examples.en: They threw a surprise party for her birthday.
examples.zh: 他们为她的生日办了一个惊喜派对。

def_zh: n. 内部, 里头；adv. 在内部, 在内心里
def_en: r on the inside

examples.en: Please reply within three working days.
examples.zh: 请在三个工作日内回复。

def_zh: vt. 种植, 使长满；vi. 生长, 变成, 发展

def_zh: n. 可能性, 可能的事；可能性, 可能发生的事, 不确定权
def_en: n. a future prospect or potential

examples.en: There is a real possibility of rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天确实有下雨的可能。

root_affix: possible(可能的) + 后缀 -ity(名词)→ 可能性

def_zh: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费；保险
def_en: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company

examples.en: They bought travel insurance before the trip.
examples.zh: 出发前他们购买了旅行保险。

root_affix: 前缀 in-(使) + sure(确定) + -ance→ 使有保障→ 保险

def_zh: n. 部门, 系, 机关；部, 科
def_en: n. a specialized division of a large organization

examples.en: She works in the marketing department.
examples.zh: 她在市场营销部门工作。

root_affix: 前缀 de-(分开) + 词根 part(部分) + -ment→ 分出的部分→ 部门

def_zh: n. 战役；v. 战斗
def_en: n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war

examples.en: The soldiers were tired after the long battle.
examples.zh: 经过漫长的战斗，士兵们都累了。

def_zh: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树；vt. 约会, 定日期
def_en: n. the specified day of the month

examples.en: Please write today's date at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 请在页面顶部写上今天的日期。

def_zh: adv. 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地
def_en: r. without distinction of one from others

examples.en: People generally feel happier in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 人们在阳光下通常会感到更愉快。

def_zh: a. 难过的, 悲哀的, 遗憾的
def_en: a feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone

examples.en: I'm sorry for keeping you waiting so long.
examples.zh: 抱歉让你等了这么久。

def_zh: n. 危机, 危险期, 紧要关头；危象; 骤退, 临界, 极期
def_en: n. an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty

examples.en: The country faced a serious water crisis.
examples.zh: 这个国家面临严重的水危机。

def_zh: n. 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者；vt. 煽动, 刺激, 吹拂
def_en: n. a device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces

examples.en: She turned on the fan to cool the warm room.
examples.zh: 她打开风扇，给温热的房间降温。

def_zh: n. 棍, 棒, 刺, 枯枝, 茎, 条状物；vt. 插进, 刺入, 钉住, 伸出, 粘贴, 停止
def_en: n. an implement consisting of a length of wood

examples.en: The dog ran to fetch the wooden stick.
examples.zh: 狗跑过去叼回那根木棍。

def_zh: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确；定义
def_en: v. give a definition for the meaning of a word

examples.en: Can you define this word in simple terms?
examples.zh: 你能用简单的语言给这个词下个定义吗？

root_affix: 前缀 de-(完全) + 词根 fin(界限)→ 划定界限→ 定义

def_zh: adv. 容易地, 轻易地, 流利地
def_en: r. with ease (`easy' is sometimes used informally for `easily')

examples.en: She finished the simple test very easily.
examples.zh: 她轻松地完成了那道简单的测试。

def_zh: n. 孔, 洞, 穴, 漏洞；vt. 挖洞, 掘坑
def_en: n. an opening into or through something

examples.en: There is a small hole in my left sock.
examples.zh: 我左边的袜子上有个小洞。

def_zh: n. 元件, 元素, 要素；部分; 成分; 单元; 码元; 元件; 元素; 单元
def_en: n. the most favorable environment for a plant or animal

examples.en: Trust is a key element of any friendship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何友谊的关键要素。

def_zh: n. 状态, 情形, 地位, 要人身份；状态
def_en: n. the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society

examples.en: Please check the current status of your order.
examples.zh: 请查看你订单的当前状态。

root_affix: 词根 stat(站立;状态)→ 所处的状态→ 地位

def_zh: n. 视觉, 眼光, 视力, 幻想；vt. 梦见, 想象, 显示
def_en: n. a vivid mental image

examples.en: The doctor said her vision was perfectly normal.
examples.zh: 医生说她的视力完全正常。

root_affix: 词根 vis(看) + -ion→ 看的能力→ 视觉

def_zh: n. 常态, 标准, 正常, 普通；a. 正常的, 正规的, 标准的, 师范的, 正态的
def_en: a. conforming with or constituting a norm or standard or level or type or social norm; not abnormal

examples.en: His temperature is back to normal today.
examples.zh: 他的体温今天恢复正常了。

root_affix: 词根 norm(规范;标准) + -al→ 符合标准的→ 正常的

def_zh: n. 船, 舰；vt. 以船运送, 装船, 运送
def_en: n. a vessel that carries passengers or freight

examples.en: The huge ship slowly left the busy harbour.
examples.zh: 那艘巨轮缓缓驶离了繁忙的港口。

root_affix: 古英语 scip 'ship'，与现代德语 Schiff 同源；后缀 -ship（如 friendship）表抽象状态，词源不同。

def_zh: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石；vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头
def_en: n. building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose

examples.en: He picked up a smooth stone and threw it.
examples.zh: 他捡起一块光滑的石头扔了出去。

root_affix: 古英语 stan 'stone'，日耳曼语根，与德语 Stein 同源。

def_zh: adv. 慢慢地, 迟缓地
def_en: r. without speed (`slow' is sometimes used informally for `slowly')

examples.en: She walked slowly along the quiet beach.
examples.zh: 她沿着宁静的海滩慢慢走着。

root_affix: slow（慢）+ 副词后缀 -ly，构成方式副词。

def_zh: n. 刻度, 衡量, 比例, 比例尺, 数值范围, 等级, 规模, 天平, 秤, 鳞, 积垢；vt. 依比例决定, 攀登, 测量, 绘制, 刮鳞, 使生垢, 过秤
def_en: n. an ordered reference standard

examples.en: We need to measure the project on a larger scale.
examples.zh: 我们需要从更大的规模来衡量这个项目。

root_affix: 源自拉丁语 scala '梯子、阶梯'，引申为刻度、等级；同根有 escalate。

def_zh: n. 驾驶员, 驱动器, 驱动程序；驱动器
def_en: n. the operator of a motor vehicle

examples.en: The bus driver waited for the late passengers.
examples.zh: 公交车司机等着迟到的乘客。

root_affix: drive（驾驶）+ 表施动者后缀 -er，意为'驾驶的人'。

def_zh: n. 污点, 地点, 斑点, 点, 娱乐场所, 处境, 少量；a. 当场的, 现场的, 现货买卖的, 现金交易的, 抽样的
def_en: n. a short section or illustration (as between radio or tv programs or in a magazine) that is often used for advertising

examples.en: This quiet spot by the river is perfect for reading.
examples.zh: 河边这处幽静的地方最适合读书了。

def_zh: n. 缺乏, 无, 不足；vt. 缺乏, 短少, 不足, 需要
def_en: n. the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable

examples.en: The team lost because of a lack of practice.
examples.zh: 球队因为缺乏练习而输掉了比赛。

root_affix: 源自中古英语/低地德语 lak '缺乏、不足'。

def_zh: n. 冰, 冰淇淋, 糖衣, 冷若冰霜, 矜持, 贿赂；vt. 使结冰, 冰镇, 覆以糖衣
def_en: n. water frozen in the solid state

examples.en: The children skated happily on the frozen ice.
examples.zh: 孩子们在结冰的冰面上快乐地滑冰。

root_affix: 古英语 is 'ice'，日耳曼语根，与德语 Eis 同源。

def_zh: n. 船；vi. 乘船
def_en: n. a small vessel for travel on water

examples.en: They rowed the small boat across the calm lake.
examples.zh: 他们划着小船穿过平静的湖面。

root_affix: 古英语 bat 'boat'，日耳曼语根。

def_zh: n. 饮料, 酒；v. 喝, 喝酒
def_en: n. a single serving of a beverage

examples.en: Would you like something cold to drink?
examples.zh: 你想喝点凉的吗？

root_affix: 古英语 drincan 'to drink'，日耳曼语根，与德语 trinken 同源。

def_zh: n. 太阳, 日, 日光, 阳光；vt. 晒
def_en: n. the star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system

examples.en: The warm sun rose slowly over the hills.
examples.zh: 温暖的太阳缓缓从山后升起。

root_affix: 古英语 sunne 'sun'，日耳曼语根；同源 Sunday（星期日）。

def_zh: n. 木材, 木制品；vt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴
def_en: n. the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees

examples.en: The old table is made of solid wood.
examples.zh: 这张旧桌子是用实木做的。

root_affix: 古英语 wudu 'wood, forest'，日耳曼语根。

def_zh: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话；vt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输
def_en: n. an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling

examples.en: A large truck delivered the furniture this morning.
examples.zh: 今早一辆大卡车送来了家具。

root_affix: 可能源自拉丁/希腊 trochos '轮子'，本指小轮车。

def_zh: n. 柄, 把手, 把柄, 柄状物, 手感；vt. 触摸, 运用, 买卖, 处理, 操作
def_en: n. the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it

examples.en: She turned the handle and opened the door.
examples.zh: 她转动把手，打开了门。

root_affix: hand（手）+ 工具后缀 -le，本义'用手操作之物'。

def_zh: n. 纵览, 视察, 测量, 俯瞰, 调查；vt. 审视, 视察, 俯瞰, 通盘考虑
def_en: n. a detailed critical inspection

examples.en: The company carried out a survey of its customers.
examples.zh: 公司对顾客进行了一次调查。

root_affix: 前缀 sur-(超过;在…之上)

def_zh: n. 冬季, 萧条期, 衰退期；a. 冬天的
def_en: n. the coldest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the winter solstice to the vernal equinox

examples.en: We often go skiing during the cold winter.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬天我们常去滑雪。

root_affix: 古英语 winter，日耳曼语根，与德语 Winter 同源。

def_zh: n. 村庄；a. 乡村的, 村庄的
def_en: n. a community of people smaller than a town

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small mountain village.
examples.zh: 我祖父母住在一个山间小村庄里。

root_affix: 源自拉丁语 villa '乡间宅邸' + 后缀 -age，表场所/集合。

def_zh: vt. 拒绝, 谢绝；vi. 拒绝
def_en: v. show unwillingness towards

examples.en: He refused to answer their personal questions.
examples.zh: 他拒绝回答他们那些私人问题。

root_affix: re-（向后、回）+ 拉丁 fundere '倒、倾'，本义'倒回、推开'，引申为拒绝。

def_zh: a. 销售的；销售
def_en: n income (at invoice values) received for goods and services over some given period of time

examples.en: Their sales increased sharply during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期期间他们的销售额大幅上升。

root_affix: sale（销售）的复数形式；sale 源自古英语 sala '出售'。

def_zh: n. 卷, 滚动, 名单, 案卷, 压路机；vi. 滚, 滚动, 飘流, 起伏, 卷, 绕
def_en: n. a list of names

examples.en: The ball began to roll down the steep hill.
examples.zh: 球开始顺着陡坡滚下去。

root_affix: 源自拉丁语 rota '轮子'，经古法语 roller，本义'转动'。

def_zh: n. 交流, 交通, 通讯；通信
def_en: n. the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information

examples.en: Good communication is the key to teamwork.
examples.zh: 良好的沟通是团队协作的关键。

root_affix: 前缀 com-(共同;一起) + 后缀 -ation(名词后缀:动作;状态)

def_zh: n. 幕, 银幕, 屏风, 掩蔽物, 屏蔽, 筛子；vt. 掩蔽, 放映, 拍摄, 掩护, 筛, 甄别
def_en: n. a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing

examples.en: She wiped the dust off the computer screen.
examples.zh: 她擦掉了电脑屏幕上的灰尘。

root_affix: 源自古法语 escren '屏风、挡板'，本指遮挡之物。

def_zh: n. 增益, 获得, 利润, 收获, 增加；vt. 得到, 增进, 赚到
def_en: n. the amount by which the revenue of a business exceeds its cost of operating

examples.en: You can gain experience by doing this job.
examples.zh: 做这份工作你能获得经验。

root_affix: 源自古法语 gaaignier '获得、耕种'。

def_zh: n. 居民, 常驻程序, 居住者, 留鸟；a. 居留的, 定居的
def_en: n. someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there

examples.en: Every resident must follow the building's rules.
examples.zh: 每位住户都必须遵守这栋楼的规定。

root_affix: re-（不断）+ 拉丁 sedere '坐'，本义'长久坐居'，引申为居民；同根 reside。

def_zh: n. 兽皮, 迹象, 躲藏处；vt. 藏, 隐瞒, 遮避, 剥...的皮, 隐藏
def_en: n. the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)

examples.en: The cat likes to hide under the warm bed.
examples.zh: 那只猫喜欢躲在暖和的床底下。

root_affix: 古英语 hydan 'to hide'，日耳曼语根。

def_zh: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵；a. 金的, 似金的, 金色的, 金制的
def_en: n. coins made of gold

examples.en: She wore a thin gold ring on her finger.
examples.zh: 她手指上戴着一枚细细的金戒指。

root_affix: 古英语 gold，日耳曼语根；与 yellow（黄）同一印欧色彩词根 ghel-。

def_zh: n. 俱乐部, 木棍, 球棒；vt. 用棍棒打, 缴纳
def_en: n. a formal association of people with similar interests

examples.en: He joined a local chess club after school.
examples.zh: 放学后他加入了一个当地的象棋俱乐部。

root_affix: 源自古诺斯语 klubba '棍棒'；'俱乐部'义由'聚拢成团'引申而来。

def_zh: n. 农场, 农田；vt. 耕种
def_en: n. workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit

examples.en: They grow vegetables on a small family farm.
examples.zh: 他们在一个小小的家庭农场里种蔬菜。

root_affix: 源自拉丁语 firma '固定付款、租约'，本指租来的土地。

def_zh: n. 潜在性, 可能性, 潜力, 潜能, 势, 位；a. 有潜力的, 可能的, 潜在的
def_en: n. the inherent capacity for coming into being

examples.en: This young player has great potential.
examples.zh: 这位年轻球员很有潜力。

root_affix: 词根 tent(伸展) + 后缀 -ial(形容词后缀:…的;有关…的)

def_zh: n. 出席, 面前, 存在, 仪态, 风度；出现
def_en: n. the state of being present; current existence

examples.en: Her calm presence made everyone feel safe.
examples.zh: 她沉着的仪态让每个人都感到安心。

root_affix: 前缀 pre-(在…之前)

def_zh: n. 独立自主者, 无党派者；a. 独立的, 有主见的, 不须依赖的, 不受约束的
def_en: a. free from external control and constraint

examples.en: She has been financially independent since college.
examples.zh: 自从大学起她就在经济上独立了。

root_affix: 前缀 in-(不;向内) + 词根 pend(悬挂;称量;支付) + 后缀 -ent(形容词/名词后缀:…的;…者)

def_zh: n. 区域, 地方；地区, 地段
def_en: n. a region marked off for administrative or other purposes

examples.en: This is the oldest district in the whole city.
examples.zh: 这是整座城市里最古老的城区。

root_affix: 前缀 dis-(不;分开;否定)

def_zh: n. 形状, 形态, 外形, 形式, 身材；vt. 定形, 使成形, 塑造, 计划, 使符合
def_en: n. any spatial attributes (especially as defined by outline)

examples.en: The cloud slowly changed into a strange shape.
examples.zh: 那朵云慢慢变成了一个奇怪的形状。

root_affix: 古英语 sceap '形成、创造'，与 shapen（成形）同源。

def_zh: n. 读者, 读物, 文选, 校对人, 讲师；阅读程序; 阅读器
def_en: n. a person who enjoys reading

examples.en: This book is perfect for a young reader.
examples.zh: 这本书非常适合年幼的读者。

root_affix: read（阅读）+ 施动者后缀 -er，意为'读者'。

def_zh: n. 合约, 婚约, 契约；vt. 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结
def_en: n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law

examples.en: Both sides signed the contract last week.
examples.zh: 上周双方签署了合同。

root_affix: 前缀 con-(共同;一起) + 词根 tract(拉;拖)

def_zh: n. 群众, 一伙人；vt. 拥挤, 挤满, 挤进
def_en: n. a large number of things or people considered together

examples.en: A huge crowd gathered to watch the parade.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚集起来观看游行。

root_affix: 古英语 crudan '推挤'，'人群'义由'拥挤'引申而来。

def_zh: n. 房间, 公寓
def_en: n. a suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house

examples.en: They rented a small apartment near the office.
examples.zh: 他们在办公室附近租了一套小公寓。

root_affix: 源自意大利语 appartare '分隔'；本义'隔开的房间'。

def_zh: a. 早先的, 前面的, 过急的；以前的, 生前的, 前述的
def_en: s. just preceding something else in time or order

examples.en: Her previous job was at a small bookshop.
examples.zh: 她之前的工作是在一家小书店。

root_affix: 前缀 pre-(在…之前)

def_zh: n. 带子, 队, 乐队；v. 联合, 结合
def_en: n. instrumentalists not including string players

examples.en: The school band played at the autumn festival.
examples.zh: 校乐队在秋季节庆上演奏。

root_affix: 源自日耳曼语 band '捆绑物'；'乐队'义由'结合的一群人'引申。

def_zh: adv. 显而易见地, 明显地
def_en: r. unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')

examples.en: She was obviously tired after the long trip.
examples.zh: 经过长途旅行后，她显然累了。

root_affix: obvious（明显的，源自拉丁 ob viam '在路上、当面'）+ 副词后缀 -ly。

def_zh: n. 马, 骑兵, 脚架；vi. 骑马, 取笑
def_en: n. solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times

examples.en: The brown horse ran quickly across the field.
examples.zh: 那匹棕马飞快地奔过田野。

root_affix: 古英语 hors 'horse'，日耳曼语根。

def_zh: n. 目标, 靶子, 指标；vt. 对准, 订指标
def_en: n. a reference point to shoot at

examples.en: The arrow hit the center of the target.
examples.zh: 箭射中了靶子的正中央。

root_affix: 源自古法语 targe '小盾牌' + 指小后缀 -et。

def_zh: n. 监狱, 监禁, 拘留所；vt. 监禁

def_zh: n. 囚犯, 罪犯；vt. 宣告有罪, 使知罪

examples.zh: 陪审团投票判定那名男子犯有盗窃罪。

def_zh: a. 本土的, 国产的, 固有的；原产的, 本土的

examples.zh: 这些植物原产于热带雨林。

examples.zh: 一粒微小的尘埃在阳光中飘浮。

def_zh: vt. 修正, 变更, 修饰, 缓和, 减轻；vi. 被修改

examples.zh: 为了降低成本,我们不得不修改设计方案。

examples.zh: 她在歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

def_zh: n. 推进, 吹捧；vt. 推进, 提高, 宣扬, 促进

examples.zh: 早上来一杯咖啡能提振你的精力。

examples.zh: 烟雾警报器在半夜响了起来。

def_zh: n. 紧握, 柄, 握力, 握手方式, 手提包, 掌握, 支配, 控制；vt. 抓紧, 抱住, 吸住, 掌握

def_zh: a. 节日的, 喜庆的, 快乐的；n. 节日, 庆祝, 欢宴

examples.zh: 这座小镇每年夏天都会举办一场音乐节。

root_affix: 源自拉丁语 festivus(欢乐的)，与 feast(盛宴)同源。

def_zh: n. 汗, 汗水, 水珠, 焦急；vi. 出汗, 渗出, 冒出水气, 结水珠, 烦恼, 懊恼

def_zh: adv. 传统上；传说上；习惯上

examples.zh: 按照传统,家人会在这一天聚在一起吃顿大餐。

def_zh: n. 投票, 投票用纸, 抽签；vi. 投票, 抽签

def_zh: adv. 无论哪里

def_zh: n. 维生素；维生素

examples.en: The storm could sever the power lines to town.
examples.zh: 暴风雨可能会切断通往镇上的电线。

def_zh: n. 小册子, 活页文选
def_en: n a small book usually having a paper cover

examples.en: The nurse gave me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
examples.zh: 护士给了我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

def_zh: n. 皮带扣, 扣子；vt. 扣住, 使弯曲
def_en: n. fastener that fastens together two ends of a belt or strap; often has loose prong

examples.en: He fastened the belt with a silver buckle.
examples.zh: 他用一个银色的扣子系上了皮带。

def_zh: n. 清除, 间隙；间隙; 空隙
def_en: n. the distance by which one thing clears another; the space between them

examples.en: There isn't enough clearance for the truck under the bridge.
examples.zh: 桥下的空间不够让卡车通过。

def_zh: n. 可可粉, 可可茶, 可可色；可可, 可可豆
def_en: n. a beverage made from cocoa powder and milk and sugar; usually drunk hot

examples.en: On cold nights I love a warm cup of cocoa.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚我喜欢喝一杯温热的可可。

def_zh: n. 无信用, 丢脸, 不名誉；vt. 不信, 怀疑, 使丢脸
def_en: v. cause to be distrusted or disbelieved

examples.en: They tried to discredit him with false rumors.
examples.zh: 他们试图用假谣言来败坏他的名声。

root_affix: 前缀 dis-(不;分开;否定) + 词根 cred(相信)

def_zh: a. 祖先的, 祖传的；祖先的, 祖传的
def_en: s. inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent

examples.en: The family returned to their ancestral home.
examples.zh: 这家人回到了他们祖传的老宅。

def_zh: n. 小面包；血液尿素氮
def_en: n. small rounded bread either plain or sweet

examples.en: I had a warm bun and some tea for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一个热乎乎的小面包和一些茶。

def_zh: int. （表示惊异、热心、高兴或不悦的叫声）哦！
def_en: v. express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'

examples.en: The crowd went "ooh" when the fireworks began.
examples.zh: 烟花开始时，人群发出"哦"的赞叹声。

def_zh: a. 程序上的；程序上的
def_en: a. of or relating to procedure

examples.en: There was a procedural error during the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议中出现了一个程序上的错误。

root_affix: 前缀 pro-(向前;赞成) + 后缀 -al(形容词后缀:…的;有关…的)

def_zh: n. 地下水
def_en: water held underground in the soil or in pores and crevices in rock

examples.en: The factory must not pollute the groundwater.
examples.zh: 这家工厂绝不能污染地下水。

def_zh: n. 畸形人, 畸形物, 不正常的事物, 反复无常；a. 奇异的, 反常的
def_en: n. a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed

examples.en: A freak storm destroyed the small village.
examples.zh: 一场反常的暴风雨摧毁了那个小村庄。

def_zh: a. 事实的, 实际的；事实的, 与事实有关的, 实际的
def_en: a. of or relating to or characterized by facts

examples.en: The report must be accurate and factual.
examples.zh: 这份报告必须准确且符合事实。

root_affix: 词根 fact(做;制作) + 后缀 -al(形容词后缀:…的;有关…的)

def_zh: vi. 行礼, 致意, 问候, 放礼炮；vt. 向...致意, 迎接, 赞扬
def_en: n. an act of honor or courteous recognition

examples.en: The soldiers stood up to salute their general.
examples.zh: 士兵们起立向他们的将军敬礼。

def_zh: n. 蕨类植物；蕨类植物
def_en: n. any of numerous flowerless and seedless vascular plants having true roots from a rhizome and fronds that uncurl upward; reproduce by spores

examples.en: A green fern grew quietly in the shady corner.
examples.zh: 一株绿色的蕨类植物静静地长在阴凉的角落里。

def_zh: n. 题字, 碑铭；划, 药量记载
def_en: n. letters inscribed (especially words engraved or carved) on something

examples.en: An old inscription was carved on the stone gate.
examples.zh: 石门上刻着一段古老的铭文。

def_zh: n. 硬木, 硬木材, 阔叶材, 落叶树；硬木
def_en: n. the wood of broad-leaved dicotyledonous trees (as distinguished from the wood of conifers)

examples.en: The table is made of strong hardwood.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是用坚固的硬木做的。

def_zh: n. 柑橘属果树
def_en: n. any of numerous fruits of the genus Citrus having thick rind and juicy pulp; grown in warm regions

examples.en: Oranges and lemons are popular citrus fruits.
examples.zh: 橙子和柠檬都是很受欢迎的柑橘类水果。

def_zh: n. 东方人, 亚洲人；a. 东方诸国的, 亚洲的, 东方的
def_en: n. a member of an Oriental race; the term is regarded as offensive by Asians (especially by Asian Americans)

examples.en: The museum has a large oriental art collection.
examples.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量的东方艺术品。

def_zh: n. 群, 大群, 蜂群, 分蜂群；vi. 分群, 群集, 聚集一块, 云集, 攀
def_en: n. a group of many things in the air or on the ground

examples.en: A swarm of bees flew over the garden.
examples.zh: 一群蜜蜂飞过花园。

def_zh: n. 继父；继父
def_en: n. the husband of your mother by a subsequent marriage

examples.en: Her stepfather taught her how to ride a bike.
examples.zh: 她的继父教她怎么骑自行车。

def_zh: n. 巨型炸弹
def_en: n. a large bomb used to demolish extensive areas (as a city block)

examples.en: The new action movie became a summer blockbuster.
examples.zh: 这部新的动作片成了夏季的大片。

def_zh: n. 混合者, 混合器, 搅拌机, 搅拌器, 混频器, (非正式)交际家, 与人相处的人；混频器, 音装置
def_en: n. club soda or fruit juice used to mix with alcohol

examples.en: She poured some juice as a mixer for the drink.
examples.zh: 她倒了一些果汁作为这杯酒的调和饮料。

def_zh: a. 潮汐的, 受潮汐影响的
def_en: a. of or relating to or caused by tides

examples.en: Fishermen study the tidal patterns of the bay.
examples.zh: 渔民们研究海湾的潮汐规律。

def_zh: n. 葡萄干
def_en: n. dried grape

examples.en: She added a handful of raisins to the bread.
examples.zh: 她往面包里加了一把葡萄干。

def_zh: n. 恶化, 衰退, 退化；变坏, 变质, 颓废, 衰退
def_en: n. a symptom of reduced quality or strength

examples.en: Doctors worried about the deterioration of his health.
examples.zh: 医生们担心他健康状况的恶化。

def_zh: vt. 温和, 缓和, 减轻；缓和, 减轻
def_en: v. make less severe or harsh

examples.en: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of pollution.
examples.zh: 植树有助于减轻污染的影响。

def_zh: n. 年代记, 记录, 编年史；vt. 把...载入编年史
def_en: v. record in chronological order; make a historical record

examples.en: Her diary chronicled the family's daily life.
examples.zh: 她的日记记录了这个家庭的日常生活。

def_zh: n. 打扰, 中断, 障碍物；间断, 阻断, 中止
def_en: n. some abrupt occurrence that interrupts an ongoing activity

examples.en: There was a short interruption during the show.
examples.zh: 演出中途有过短暂的中断。

root_affix: 前缀 inter-(在…之间;相互) + 后缀 -tion(名词后缀:动作;状态)

def_zh: n. 不安的状态, 动荡的局面；不安
def_en: n. a feeling of restless agitation

examples.en: There was growing unrest among the workers.
examples.zh: 工人们之间的不安情绪日益增长。

def_zh: vt. 缓和, 使安静, 安慰, 奉承；vi. 起安慰作用
def_en: v. cause to feel better

examples.en: The soft music helped to soothe the crying baby.
examples.zh: 轻柔的音乐帮助安抚了哭闹的婴儿。

def_zh: n. 实验, 试验, 实验法；实验; 实验过程
def_en: n the testing of an idea

examples.en: Science grows through careful experimentation.
examples.zh: 科学通过细致的实验而发展。

def_zh: n. 扣子, 钩, 紧握；v. 扣紧, 紧握
def_en: n. a fastener (as a buckle or hook) that is used to hold two things together

examples.en: The necklace has a tiny gold clasp.
examples.zh: 这条项链有一个小小的金扣子。

def_zh: n. 障碍, 妨碍, 闭塞物；梗阻, 不通
def_en: n. any structure that makes progress difficult

examples.en: A fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树成了路上的障碍物。

root_affix: 词根 stru(建造;构造) + 后缀 -tion(名词后缀:动作;状态)

def_zh: n. 拖, 拖绳, 拖轮；vt. 拖, 拉, 牵引
def_en: n. the act of hauling something (as a vehicle) by means of a hitch or rope

examples.en: A truck came to tow our broken car away.
examples.zh: 一辆卡车来把我们抛锚的汽车拖走了。

def_zh: vi. 脸红, 羞愧；vt. 弄成红色
def_en: n. sudden reddening of the face (as from embarrassment or guilt or shame or modesty)

examples.en: She began to blush when everyone praised her.
examples.zh: 大家夸奖她时，她开始脸红了。

def_zh: n. 邮筒, 邮箱；邮箱, 电子邮箱
def_en: n. a private box for delivery of mail

examples.en: I found a letter waiting in my mailbox.
examples.zh: 我发现邮箱里有一封等待我的信。

def_zh: n. 优势, 有利情况
def_en: n. place or situation affording some advantage (especially a comprehensive view or commanding perspective)

examples.en: From this vantage point we can see the whole valley.
examples.zh: 从这个有利位置我们能看到整个山谷。

def_zh: n. 石棉；石棉
def_en: n. a fibrous amphibole; used for making fireproof articles; inhaling fibers can cause asbestosis or lung cancer

examples.en: Old buildings sometimes contain dangerous asbestos.
examples.zh: 老建筑里有时含有危险的石棉。

def_zh: n. 变更, 改动；变更
def_en: n. the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)

examples.en: The dress needs a small alteration to fit better.
examples.zh: 这条裙子需要稍作改动才能更合身。

def_zh: n. 砂砾, 粗砂石；vt. 覆以砂砾, 咬牙切齿地说
def_en: n. a hard coarse-grained siliceous sandstone

examples.en: Some grit got into my shoe during the walk.
examples.zh: 散步时有些砂砾跑进了我的鞋里。

def_zh: n. 半岛, 突出的地方, 伊比利亚半岛
def_en: n. a large mass of land projecting into a body of water

examples.en: The small town sits on a narrow peninsula.
examples.zh: 这个小镇坐落在一个狭窄的半岛上。

def_zh: n. 小池, 水坑, 胶土；vt. 搅浊, 搅炼
def_en: n. a mixture of wet clay and sand that can be used to line a pond and that is impervious to water when dry

examples.en: The child jumped happily into the muddy puddle.
examples.zh: 孩子开心地跳进泥泞的水坑里。

def_zh: vt. 击退, 保护, 供养
def_en: v. try to manage without help

examples.en: After college he learned to fend for himself.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后他学会了自己照顾自己。

def_zh: n. 百叶窗, 关闭物, 照相机快门, 关闭者；vt. 为...装百叶窗, 以百叶窗遮闭
def_en: n. a mechanical device on a camera that opens and closes to control the time of a photographic exposure

examples.en: She closed the shutter to keep out the sun.
examples.zh: 她关上百叶窗以挡住阳光。

def_zh: n. 常春藤；a. 学院的, 抽象的
def_en: n. Old World vine with lobed evergreen leaves and black berrylike fruits

examples.en: Green ivy climbed all over the old stone wall.
examples.zh: 绿色的常春藤爬满了古老的石墙。

def_zh: a. 幻像的, 幻想的, 梦想的；n. 有眼力的人, 空想家, 梦想者
def_en: n. a person given to fanciful speculations and enthusiasms with little regard for what is actually possible

examples.en: The visionary leader dreamed of a better city.
examples.zh: 这位有远见的领袖梦想着一个更美好的城市。

def_zh: n. 象征主义, 符号论；象征主义
def_en: n. a system of symbols and symbolic representations

examples.en: The painting is full of religious symbolism.
examples.zh: 这幅画充满了宗教象征意义。

def_zh: a. 可疑的, 疑心的, 不明确的；怀疑的, 有疑问的, 未确的
def_en: s. open to doubt or suspicion

examples.en: It is doubtful whether he will come tomorrow.
examples.zh: 他明天是否会来还很难说。

def_zh: vt. 轻视
def_en: v look down on with disdain

examples.en: She seemed to despise people who lie.
examples.zh: 她似乎很鄙视那些说谎的人。

def_zh: n. 沮丧；vt. 使惊愕, 使气馁
def_en: v. fill with apprehension or alarm; cause to be unpleasantly surprised

examples.en: To my dismay, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 令我沮丧的是，火车已经开走了。

root_affix: 前缀 dis-(不;分开;否定)

def_zh: a. 可从中得到乐趣的, 令人愉快的
def_en: s. affording satisfaction or pleasure

examples.en: We had an enjoyable afternoon at the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园度过了一个愉快的下午。

def_zh: n. 侵入者, 干扰者, 妨碍者；入侵者
def_en: n. someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission

examples.en: The dog barked loudly at the intruder.
examples.zh: 那只狗对着入侵者大声吠叫。

def_zh: n. 二重唱
def_en: n two items of the same kind

examples.en: The singing duo performed at the school concert.
examples.zh: 这个二人组合在学校音乐会上演出。

def_zh: n. 无性系；代用件
def_en: n. a group of genetically identical cells or organisms derived from a single cell or individual by some kind of asexual reproduction

examples.en: Scientists made a clone of the sheep.
examples.zh: 科学家克隆了那只羊。

def_zh: n. 果冻, 果冻甜食, 胶状物；v. (使)结冻, (使)成胶状
def_en: n. a preserve made of the jelled juice of fruit

examples.en: The children spread jelly on their toast.
examples.zh: 孩子们在烤面包上抹了果冻。

def_zh: vt. 效法, 尽力赶上, 同...竞争；仿真
def_en: v. strive to equal or match, especially by imitating

examples.en: Young players try to emulate their favorite stars.
examples.zh: 年轻球员努力效仿他们最喜欢的明星。

def_zh: n. 仪式；a. 正式的
def_en: s. marked by pomp or ceremony or formality

examples.en: The king wore his ceremonial robes at the event.
examples.zh: 国王在仪式上穿着他的礼袍。

def_zh: n. 膀胱, 囊；囊, 膀胱
def_en: n. a distensible membranous sac (usually containing liquid or gas)

examples.en: Drinking too much water filled his bladder quickly.
examples.zh: 喝太多水使他的膀胱很快就胀满了。

def_zh: n. 重复的话, 叠句, 副歌；vi. 节制, 避免, 克制
def_en: n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers

examples.en: Everyone sang the refrain of the happy song.
examples.zh: 大家一起唱起这首欢快歌曲的副歌。

def_zh: a. 未触摸过的, 未改变的, 未受影响的
def_en: s. still full

examples.en: She left her dinner untouched on the plate.
examples.zh: 她把晚饭原封不动地留在盘子里。

def_zh: a. 大方的, 丰富的, 浪费的；vt. 浪费, 滥用, 慷慨给予
def_en: v. expend profusely; also used with abstract nouns

examples.en: They held a lavish wedding in a grand hotel.
examples.zh: 他们在一家豪华酒店举办了奢华的婚礼。

def_zh: n. 舞厅, 跳舞场
def_en: n. large room used mainly for dancing

examples.en: The guests danced all night in the ballroom.
examples.zh: 客人们在舞厅里跳了一整夜舞。

def_zh: n. 指节, 蹄爪, 膝关节；v. 以指节打, 以手指射
def_en: n. a joint of a finger when the fist is closed

examples.en: He hurt his knuckle when he hit the wall.
examples.zh: 他打到墙上时弄伤了指关节。

def_zh: 机密性；保密
def_en: n. the state of being secret

examples.en: Doctors must protect the confidentiality of patients.
examples.zh: 医生必须保护病人的隐私信息。

root_affix: 前缀 con-(共同;一起) + 后缀 -ity(名词后缀:性质;状态)

def_zh: a. 回顾的, 怀旧的, 在后面的；n. 回顾展
def_en: n. an exhibition of a representative selection of an artist's life work

examples.en: The museum held a retrospective of her early work.
examples.zh: 博物馆举办了她早期作品的回顾展。

root_affix: 前缀 re-(再次;向后) + 词根 spect(看) + 后缀 -ive(形容词后缀:有…倾向的;…性质的)

def_zh: n. 旅行者, 朝圣者, 香客；vi. 朝圣
def_en: n. someone who journeys in foreign lands

examples.en: Every pilgrim walked the long road to the temple.
examples.zh: 每一位朝圣者都走过通往寺庙的漫长道路。

def_zh: a. 美国中西部的
def_en: s. of a region of the United States generally including Ohio; Indiana; Illinois; Iowa; Missouri; Kansas; Nebraska; and sometimes Michigan; Wisconsin; Minnesota

examples.en: She grew up in a small midwestern town.
examples.zh: 她在美国中西部的一个小镇长大。

def_zh: n. 清单, (美)选举人名单, 名册, 目录册
def_en: n. a list of items (names or tasks etc.) to be checked or consulted

examples.en: The pilot reviewed his checklist before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飞行员在起飞前检查了他的清单。

def_zh: n. 里程碑, 里程石, 里程标
def_en: n. stone post at side of a road to show distances

examples.en: Her first job was an important milestone in her life.
examples.zh: 她的第一份工作是她人生中一个重要的里程碑。

def_zh: vt. 缩减, 剥夺, 简略；剥夺特权
def_en: v place restrictions on

examples.en: The school had to curtail its sports programs.
examples.zh: 学校不得不削减它的体育项目。

def_zh: n. 联邦, 联合, 联盟；联邦, 联盟, 联邦政府
def_en: n. an organization formed by merging several groups or parties

examples.en: Several small states joined to form a federation.
examples.zh: 几个小国联合起来组成了一个联邦。

def_zh: n. 食篮, 阻碍物, 食盒；vt. 阻碍, 使困累, 妨碍, 牵制
def_en: n. a basket usually with a cover

examples.en: Heavy rain may hamper our travel plans.
examples.zh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们的出行计划。

def_zh: vi. 再出现
def_en: v. appear again

examples.en: The sun will reappear after the storm passes.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后太阳会再次出现。

def_zh: n. 血统, 直系；血统, 世系
def_en: n. the descendants of one individual

examples.en: He is proud of his long family lineage.
examples.zh: 他为自己悠久的家族血统感到自豪。

def_zh: n. 希腊字母表的第二个字母；β(希腊文的第二个字母), 乙种
def_en: n. the 2nd letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet.
examples.zh: Beta 是希腊字母表的第二个字母。

def_zh: n. 箴言, 座右铭, 警句
def_en: n. a favorite saying of a sect or political group

examples.en: Their family motto is "never give up".
examples.zh: 他们家的座右铭是"永不放弃"。

def_zh: a. 草药的；本草书
def_en: a. of or relating to herbs

examples.en: She drinks herbal tea before going to bed.
examples.zh: 她睡前会喝草药茶。

def_zh: n. 素食者, 食草动物；a. 素食的
def_en: n. eater of fruits and grains and nuts; someone who eats no meat or fish or (often) any animal products

examples.en: My brother is a vegetarian and eats no meat.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是素食者，不吃肉。

def_zh: a. 芬香的, 馥郁的, 愉快的
def_en: a. pleasant-smelling

examples.en: The garden was full of fragrant roses.
examples.zh: 花园里满是芬芳的玫瑰。

def_zh: n. 宴会

def_zh: 串并转换, 并行化
def_en: (computing) to convert serialized data back into an object or data structure

examples.en: The app must deserialize the file into usable objects.
examples.zh: 应用必须把文件反序列化成可用的对象。

def_zh: n. 枚举, 列举型别；电话号码映射
def_en: (computing) short for enumeration; a data type consisting of a set of named constant values

examples.en: We defined an enum to list the four seasons.
examples.zh: 我们定义了一个枚举来列出四个季节。

def_zh: 哈希表
def_en: (computing) a data structure that maps keys to values using a hash function for fast lookup

examples.en: A hashtable stores keys and values for fast lookup.
examples.zh: 哈希表存储键和值以便快速查找。

def_zh: 幂等
def_en: s. unchanged in value following multiplication by itself

examples.en: This request is idempotent, so repeating it is safe.
examples.zh: 这个请求是幂等的，所以重复调用也很安全。

def_zh: n. 互斥量；互斥；互斥元, 互斥体
def_en: (computing) a mechanism that prevents multiple threads from accessing a shared resource at the same time

examples.en: A mutex prevents two threads from changing the data together.
examples.zh: 互斥量可以防止两个线程同时修改数据。

def_zh: 兼容补丁
def_en: (computing) code that implements a feature on web browsers that do not natively support it

examples.en: We added a polyfill so old browsers support the feature.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个兼容补丁，让旧浏览器也支持这个功能。

def_zh: 垫底
def_en: (computing) to move or reapply a sequence of commits onto a new base commit in version control

examples.en: I will rebase my branch onto the latest main.
examples.zh: 我会把我的分支变基到最新的主分支上。

def_zh: 正则表达式
def_en: (computing) short for regular expression; a pattern used to match combinations of characters in text

examples.en: He wrote a regexp to find all the email addresses.
examples.zh: 他写了一个正则表达式来查找所有电子邮件地址。

def_zh: 路由
def_en: the process of selecting a path for traffic in a network, or directing something along a route

examples.en: The routing rules decide where each request goes.
examples.zh: 路由规则决定每个请求被发送到哪里。

def_zh: 集合
def_en: to put something in a particular place or position; also, a group of similar things that belong together

examples.en: A set stores unique items without any duplicates.
examples.zh: 集合存储不重复的唯一元素。

def_zh: n. 结构；结构体；创建构架数组
def_en: (computing) a composite data type that groups together several variables under a single name

examples.en: We use a struct to group related data together.
examples.zh: 我们用结构体把相关的数据组织在一起。

root_affix: 词根 struct(建造;构造)

def_zh: n. 元组, 重数
def_en: (computing and mathematics) an ordered list of elements, often of a fixed length

examples.en: A tuple holds several values in a fixed order.
examples.zh: 元组按固定顺序保存若干个值。

def_zh: 下溢；底流
def_en: (computing) a condition in which a number is smaller than the smallest value a system can represent

examples.en: Subtracting too much can cause a number underflow error.
examples.zh: 减得太多可能会导致数字下溢错误。

root_affix: 前缀 under-(在下;不足)
